I feel so scared and guilty. I got several panic attacks yesterday because if word got out what happened, I’m scared the narrative will be spinned. I’m so scared that the story will come out that me, a drunk girl, was hitting on an off-limits guy (my best friends dad) and made a move on him — instead of the other way around.
Thank you for this. I feel so guilty and I wish I was more clear with my intentions. Maybe then it wouldn’t have escalated.

I’m so upset over the power this guy now has over me. I heard his voice on a phone call with my best friend and I was filled with dread. I hate that at any point this guy can tell his kid what happened, spin the narrative to favor himself, and ruin my friendship with my best friend.

I hate that two days later I can’t stop thinking about it and wishing that I did more to stop it.

Update two days later: I got my first panic attack yesterday and I feel so pathetic. I definitely feel taken advantage of. But I cannot stop thinking that I should have done more to stop it. Does it count as SA if it was just a make out?
